questions.prompt: Telling someone about a trip: Your partner is deciding what to do after this account. Give a relevant suggestion, ask about one missing practical detail, and respond aloud to the possibility that their plan differs.
questions.context:
昨天我和朋友去中国看老师。我是坐火车去的，朋友是坐飞机去的。我坐了三个小时，朋友坐了两个小时。

我到了车站，朋友打电话说：“我在学校。”我说：“你在学校等我吧，我从车站坐车去。”

我们下午在学校见面。朋友等了我十分钟。明天我们不坐飞机，也不坐火车，我们走路去商店。
questions.label: Take your speaking turn

rubric.text: My suggestion follows from the source situation.
I asked about a real missing detail and allowed a different plan.
